text:
Clara: Flagging an odd one from this morning - some scorecards exported from Orbit to Greenhouse show 'role-fit' answers mapped to a different label 'team-chem' so our hiring dashboard is showing inconsistent distributions.
Jon: Oof. Is this a field-mapping change in the new export pipeline? We rolled a mapping tweak last night.
Clara: Looks like it. Candidates cand-1201 and cand-1202 show identical answers but column headers differ, so averages per competency are inconsistent.
Mei: I dug into the ETL job - the transform uses a label map file that got updated with a legacy alias list. The alias 'collab' was mapped to 'team-chem' and somehow role-fit also included 'collab' as a synonym.
Arun: For panels happening today, this will skew comparisons across candidates. We need a quick reconciliation step.
Priya: Short-term process: hiring managers should rely on the per-interviewer raw score JSON (we can attach) instead of the dashboard. I'll publish a template asking them to confirm any surprising deltas before debrief decisions.
Jon: I'll revert the mapping change on staging and push a hotfix to prod. Also creating a migration that normalizes existing exports to use canonical labels.
Mei: Good. For reconciliation I can run a script that re-maps ambiguous alias values to the canonical key with a reason code 'migrated_label_v1' and attach a note to affected candidate timelines.
Clara: Can we also add a UI tooltip that shows the canonical rubric id and version on the scorecard so interviewers know which mapping applies? That would avoid silent aliasing.
Arun: Agree. Also adding a mandatory one-line confirmation for new interviewers: "I used rubric v2 (25/25/50)" before submit so we don't mix rubric versions.
ops-bot: INF-2219 created: "export label alias collision causing dashboard mismatch". Priority: P2. Owner: Jon.
hiring-bot: Micro-training published: "Scorecard labels & export sanity (5m)" pinned to #hiring-resources. :bookmark_tabs:
Priya: I'll send a short note to hiring managers with the reconciliation steps and the list of affected candidate IDs. Also scheduling a 15-min async refresher for schedulers and interviewers tomorrow.
Jon: Hotfix deployed to prod, running the normalization job now. ETA ~40m. I'll post CSV of affected exports when ready.
Mei: Normalization dry-run shows 18 exports touched, 12 with ambiguous aliases. I'll include checksum and before/after in OPS-2219.
Clara: Thanks team. Once normalized, let's run a short audit to ensure no historical panels get silently changed - add a change log entry for transparency. I'll follow up in OPS-2219.
